scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @spark-x-test/contracts && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/case-schema && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/execution-engine && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/executors && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/reporting && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/service-runtime && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/adapter-spark-x-agent
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @spark-x-test/api && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/scheduler && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/worker && npm run build -w @spark-x-test/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:contracts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,scheduler,worker -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @spark-x-test/web" "npm run dev -w @spark-x-test/api" "npm run dev -w @spark-x-test/scheduler" "npm run dev -w @spark-x-test/worker"
